summary: Singapore-based Trident Digital Tech Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $15 million registered direct offering of 30,000,000 Class B ordinary shares at $0.50 per share under Securities Purchase Agreements dated September 27, 2026 with certain investors. The price is a steep 65.8% discount to the $1.46 Nasdaq close on September 25, 2026. Gross proceeds are payable in USDC and/or USDT for a digital asset reserve and working capital. No underwriter or placement agent is involved; closing is expected on or about September 29, 2026. Watch dilution and crypto-treasury execution risk.
